name: Growing
label: Kranky
lede: Kevin Doria played bass, Joe Denardo played left-handed guitar, and in Olympia they ran volume pedals into several amps at once and called it Growing. Brooklyn gave them a beat; the comeback gave them sides that run 20 minutes.

eras.title: Olympia, and a lot of volume pedals
eras.text: Growing started in Olympia, Washington, with bass, guitar and drums and a taste for the Velvet Underground, Spacemen 3 and Acid Mothers Temple. Two long, slow records for Kranky put the band on the label of Stars of the Lid and Labradford; then Kevin Doria and Joe Denardo took the sound to Brooklyn as a duo.

yt: Growing at the Capitol Backstage, Olympia, 2001
years.h: Doria, Denardo and Carlson start Growing in Olympia
years.p: Kevin Doria on bass, Joe Denardo on guitar, Zack Carlson on drums: slow instrumental drones from delay and looper pedals, feedback, EBow and phrase samplers. The line is Denardo's, on the gear.
years.xp: Denardo is left-handed and Doria right-handed, so on stage they mirror each other. Both run their effects chains into several amps at once for a stereo spread. AllMusic names the Velvet Underground, Spacemen 3 and Acid Mothers Temple as the starting points.

years.h: Above/Below Sea Level comes as two tapes you play at once
years.p: After a run of self-released tapes, Growing put out a double cassette meant to run simultaneously, through Michigan's Animal Disguise. Two earlier cassettes were reissued as one release.
years.xp: AllMusic compares the idea to [[The Flaming Lips|1f43d76f-8edf-44f6-aaf1-b65f05ad9402]]' Zaireeka, the four-CD album meant for four players at once. AllMusic also lists the Dry Drunk on Woman 7-inch among the early releases.

yt: The Sky's Run into the Sea, full album
years.h: The Sky's Run into the Sea lands on Kranky as KRANK060
years.p: Recorded at Headquarters in Olympia between November 2002 and February 2003. Two of the pieces run past 17 minutes.
years.xp: The Discogs credits list Eryn Ross, Joe Denardo and Kevin Doria, with Stefan Simikich co-recording and Kanako Wynkoop on vocal assistance. The track list is printed alphabetically on the sleeve, and the gatefold has Growing embossed on the front.

years.h: Carlson is out, and the duo heads for Brooklyn
years.p: After The Sky's Run into the Sea, Denardo and Doria move to Brooklyn and the drummer leaves. AllMusic says they filled the gap with more effects and loops.

years.h: The Soul of the Rainbow and the Harmony of Light is made at home
years.p: Growing's second Kranky album (KRANK073) was recorded and mixed at home and at Magnetic Park in 2003 and 2004. Doria plays guitar and bass beside Denardo.
years.xp: Animal Disguise issued a vinyl edition. Early versions circulated as the Early Stages CD-R.

eras.title: Brooklyn finds the beat
eras.text: In Brooklyn the band left Kranky for Megablade, Troubleman and The Social Registry. The ten-minute drones got shorter and began to push forward, and in 2008 the duo toured Europe with Boris.

years.h: His Return opens a three-album run on Megablade
years.p: Conspiracy Records put out Live on CD and double LP the same year.

years.h: Doria's side project Total Life starts at 150 copies
years.p: Total Life's first album came out on Animal Disguise in an edition of 150. A 500-copy vinyl followed in 2007, and Ken Bradshaw in March 2008.

years.h: Color Wheel starts cutting the drones down
years.p: The second Megablade album is where the pieces begin to shorten.

years.h: Vision Swim goes out on two labels at once
years.p: Megablade and Troubleman Unlimited release it jointly. Late in 2007 Growing starts with The Social Registry on the Social Club Nº 8 7-inch.

years.cap: Joe Denardo and Kevin Doria at Netmage, Bologna
years.h: Boris takes Growing across Europe and the UK
years.p: Doria and Denardo spend April 2008 on the road with the Japanese heavy band [[Boris|57652bf8-cfe8-42e7-b9a7-5572a7080d8d]].

yt: Wrong Ride, video film posted by Joe Denardo
years.h: All the Way swaps ten-minute pieces for songs
years.p: After the mini-album Lateral, the full album for The Social Registry runs tracks of three to seven minutes.

eras.title: A third member and a Vice deal
eras.text: Sadie Laska of the Brooklyn noise band IUD joined on samplers and microphone, and Growing signed to Vice Records. The drone band now had rhythm, a voice and a single.

years.h: Sadie Laska of IUD makes Growing a trio
years.p: She plays samplers and microphone. The new line-up records PUMPS! with Barry London at O'Cropolis in Brooklyn in 2009.

years.cap: Growing at the Biltmore, Vancouver, April 2010
yt: Growing, Electric Independence teaser (Vice Records TV)
years.h: PUMPS! arrives on Vice, with a single called Camera '84
years.p: The first album with Laska is rhythm-driven and short-form. The Village Voice covered the single, the record and the new member in March.
years.xp: Discogs dates the Vice CD to April 8, 2010, a few weeks after the Village Voice piece ran. The credits show Barry London recording at O'Cropolis, the Brooklyn room the trio used the year before.

years.h: Godspeed You! Black Emperor picks Growing for its ATP weekend
years.p: The December 2010 All Tomorrow's Parties weekend, curated by [[Godspeed You! Black Emperor|3648db01-b29d-4ab9-835c-83f6a5068fe4]], has Growing on the bill.

eras.title: Twenty minutes a side
eras.text: After a long hiatus Doria and Denardo came back as the whole band, with small-run records on Important and Silver Current and pieces as long as anything from the Olympia years.

years.h: Disorder ends the hiatus with two 20-minute sides
years.p: The first album since PUMPS! is pressed in a numbered edition of 250 with a screen-printed jacket on Important Records.
Doria and Denardo's limited LP for Silver Current.

years.h: Gainer is Silver Current's second Growing release in a year
years.p: It follows Diptych. That February the band played a full set at Union Pool in Brooklyn.
